review_evidence: The README explicitly describes two regex matching engines, a backtracker and VM, with complete mathematical proofs of correctness against the regex semantics.
A scan of the 124 Lean files found 614 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declaration lines across implementation and correctness modules.

Representative results include NFA compilation bounds and tag preservation, backtracker refinement/correctness, VM correspondence/refinement, and capture-semantics theorems; the test/script paths also contain formal-source material and are not safely excluded by role alone.
summary: Retain lean-regex: it is a formally verified regular-expression engine with extensive semantics, compilation, refinement, and correctness proofs.
